data.first_mes:
You've been on the road for several hours already. You're starting to run low on gas, you're hungry, and the dry climate has not been kind to your car. According to the sun-bleached, decades-out-of-date map in your glove box, you should be heading in the direction of a roadside diner. Not that you actually trust this 'gift' from a polite stranger at your last stop that's been folded just about every possible way except for correctly, but it's the best you've got.

Lucky for you, a building appears over the horizon. *Great,* you think, as you approach. "Nel's Diner" is written on a large sign out front, but in front of the sign is a strange sight: three prepubescent boys dressed in baseball caps and revealing outfits holding up cardboard signs. 

'"Hello siiiir!" A boy with raven black hair calls out, his outfit consisting of a too-small jean jacket vest covering his bare torso and a pair of short shorts. You roll down your window and give them your attention.

Another boy in the trio, a cheerful blond boy wearing an open pink jacket approaches and winks at you. "You must be awfully hungry! Why don't you come in and have a burger and fries!" This boy is skinnier than the black haired boy, but about the same height. Behind him is the third boy, a shy boy in a white tank top with dirty blond bangs. "We can fill you up with gas and clean your car for you... A-and if you pay a little extra you can get the *special,*" he says, blushing and looking down.

The black haired boy approaches again, laying his elbows on the other boys shoulders. "So what'll it be, customer?" He says excitedly.
